en.title: Project CMSY++ Results under Fishing Scenarios
en.description:
This function projects each stock forward from the results of `cmsy_run()` under fishing
mortality scenarios (by default 0.5, 0.6, 0.8 and 0.95 Fmsy, as in Froese et al. 2018, and the
last-year fishing mortality) or constant catches, and draws the projected B/Bmsy and catch.
en.details:
CMSY++16.R has no projection, so it is done here with the CMSY++ model itself: the Schaefer
surplus-production model in which productivity declines linearly below B/k = 0.25 (CMSY++16.R
and Froese et al. 2023), started from the posterior draws of r, k and last-year B/k of the
run (which come from the same MCMC iterations), with lognormal process error (`sigma`, 0.1 by
default as `sigmaR` in CMSY++). As in CMSY++, the biomass of a year is the biomass before the
catch of that year, F is the catch divided by that biomass, and F/Fmsy uses an Fmsy reduced
linearly below half of Bmsy (CMSY++16.R). The catch of the last year of the data is kept, so
the biomass of the next year is that of the CMSY++ model; the scenarios set the catch from the
first projected year on. In the F scenarios the catch is the scenario F times the biomass of
the same year, so F/Fmsy is the scenario value.

Stocks whose data end in different years are each projected from their own last year to the
same final year (the latest last year plus `years`); the share of stocks at or above Bmsy is
given from the latest last year on, when every stock has a value.
en.value:
Invisibly, a list with `projection` (by stock, scenario and year: median B/Bmsy,
F/Fmsy and catch with 95% limits, and the probability that B is at least Bmsy) and
`share` (by scenario and year: share of stocks at or above Bmsy, with 95% limits, and
the number of stocks).

arguments.stocks:
Optional stocks to project: `Stock` identifiers or species, by English or Chinese
FAO name, scientific name or FAO 3-alpha code. Default is NULL, all stocks that ran.
arguments.years: Number of years to project after the latest last year of the stocks. Default is 10.
arguments.f: Fishing mortality scenarios as multiples of Fmsy. Default is `c(0.5, 0.6, 0.8, 0.95)`.
arguments.status_quo:
A logical value. If TRUE (default), the last-year fishing mortality is also
projected.
arguments.catch:
Optional constant catches to project, in tonnes per year (e.g. the last-year
catch).
arguments.sigma: Standard deviation of the lognormal process error. Default is 0.1.
arguments.plot, table:
Whether charts (`figures/png/cmsy/<stock>/forecast.png` and
`figures/png/cmsy/summary/forecast_share.png`) and the table (`tables/cmsy/`) are saved.
Default is TRUE.
arguments.lang:
The language of the chart text and names: "en" (English), "zh" (Chinese) or
"both" (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with
`fao_settings()` ("en" unless changed).
arguments.annotations:
The text added to the axis titles and labels: FALSE (default) none, TRUE
all, or any of "title", "subtitle", "caption", "legend" and "labels" (text inside the
chart). The default can be changed for the session with
`options(faofishingreport.cmsy_annotations = TRUE)`.
arguments.pptx:
A logical value. If TRUE, the charts are also saved as editable PowerPoint files in
figures/pptx/cmsy/<stock>/ and figures/pptx/cmsy/summary/. Default is FALSE, which can be
changed for all functions with `fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)`.
arguments.silent:
A logical value. If FALSE (default), a progress bar shows how many stocks have
been projected. If TRUE, nothing is printed. The default can be changed for the session
with `fao_settings(silent = TRUE)`.

zh.title: 不同捕捞情景下的CMSY++预测
zh.description: 本函数根据`cmsy_run()`的结果，在不同捕捞死亡率情景（默认为0.5、0.6、0.8和0.95倍Fmsy，与Froese等（2018）相同，以及最后一年的捕捞死亡率）或固定渔获量下对每个种群向前预测，并绘制预测的B/Bmsy和渔获量。
zh.details:
CMSY++16.R本身没有预测功能，因此这里用CMSY++的模型本身进行预测：生产力在B/k = 0.25以下线性下降的Schaefer剩余产量模型（CMSY++16.R和Froese等，2023），从本次运行中r、k和最后一年B/k的后验抽样值（来自相同的MCMC迭代）出发，并加入对数正态过程误差（`sigma`，默认为0.1，与CMSY++中的`sigmaR`相同）。与CMSY++相同，某一年的生物量是该年捕捞之前的生物量，F是渔获量除以该生物量，F/Fmsy所用的Fmsy在生物量低于Bmsy的一半时线性降低（CMSY++16.R）。保留数据最后一年的渔获量，因此下一年的生物量即为CMSY++模型给出的生物量；各情景从预测的第一年起设定渔获量。在F情景中，渔获量等于情景的F乘以同一年的生物量，因此F/Fmsy等于情景值。

数据结束年份不同的种群，各自从其最后一年预测到同一个最终年份（各种群最后一年中最晚的一年加上`years`）；处于或高于Bmsy的种群所占比例从这一最晚的最后一年起给出，此时每个种群都有值。
zh.value: 以不可见方式返回一个列表，包含`projection`（按种群、情景和年份：B/Bmsy、F/Fmsy和渔获量的中位数及95%置信限，以及B至少达到Bmsy的概率）和`share`（按情景和年份：处于或高于Bmsy的种群所占比例及其95%置信限，以及种群数）。

arguments.stocks: 要预测的种群（可选）：`Stock`标识，或物种的FAO英文或中文名称、学名或FAO三字母代码。默认为NULL，即所有已运行的种群。
arguments.years: 在各种群最后一年中最晚的一年之后预测的年数。默认为10。
arguments.f: 以Fmsy倍数表示的捕捞死亡率情景。默认为`c(0.5, 0.6, 0.8, 0.95)`。
arguments.status_quo: 逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，还按最后一年的捕捞死亡率进行预测。
arguments.catch: 要预测的固定渔获量（可选），单位为吨/年（例如最后一年的渔获量）。
arguments.sigma: 对数正态过程误差的标准差。默认为0.1。
arguments.plot, table: 是否保存图表（`figures/png/cmsy/<stock>/forecast.png`和`figures/png/cmsy/summary/forecast_share.png`）和表格（tables/cmsy/）。默认为TRUE。
arguments.lang: 图表文字和名称的语言："en"（英文）、"zh"（中文）或"both"（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用`fao_settings()`设置的语言（未更改时为"en"）。
arguments.annotations: 在坐标轴标题和坐标轴标签之外添加的文字：FALSE（默认）不添加，TRUE全部添加，或"title"、"subtitle"、"caption"、"legend"和"labels"（图内文字）中的任意几项。可以用`options(faofishingreport.cmsy_annotations = TRUE)`更改本次R会话的默认值。
arguments.pptx: 逻辑值。为TRUE时，图表还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件，保存在`figures/pptx/cmsy/<stock>/`和`figures/pptx/cmsy/summary/`。默认为FALSE，可以用`fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)`为所有函数统一更改。
arguments.silent: 逻辑值。为FALSE（默认）时，用进度条显示已完成预测的种群数；为TRUE时不输出任何内容。可以用`fao_settings(silent = TRUE)`更改本次R会话的默认值。
